title: Gender and content bias in Large Language Models: a case study on Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's acceptance and rejection rates when responding to otherwise identical prompts that are neutral, male-specific, or female-specific (e.g., 'To kill a man' vs. 'To kill a woman').
Evaluating disparities in moderation permissiveness by comparing the model's acceptance rates for prompts requesting explicit sexual content versus those requesting violent or drug-related content.
